summary: Workflow references tests/mocks/mock-lookup.sh in chmod and shellcheck steps (~lines 30–31, 35–36) but file not provided; chmod/shellcheck would fail. Script's design (LICENSE_LOOKUP_CMD env var) makes external mock script unnecessary—either remove references or supply file. Bash script is well-structured (modular functions, testable via sourcing, proper error codes), but unreferenced file breaks CI/CD. Double-run of license-checker (text+JSON) is redundant; JSON could derive from stdout. Would not execute successfully via act.
